review: TargetFormsTest preserves the entire originally invalid mixed target configuration; Java forwards exact alias/version/full/partial/foreign target. Rust rejects invalid self/cross-region target configuration, no credit for the individual target validation branch. The original WP2 CapturingProxy isEnabled unconditionally returns true even when config omits enabled. New ConformanceAlwaysEnabledProxy mirrors this explicit test-only behavior using the retained constructor seam; configuration is not repaired to enabled=true. Rust rejects this synthetic plugin at Init, so no individual Rust target-policy branch is counted.
